factories.name: new_list_scheduled_events_step
factories.description: List one page of scheduled events that start inside a required time window, for a user, an organization, or the connected user.

inputSchema.description: ListScheduledEventsInput selects one page of scheduled events.

inviteeEmail.description: InviteeEmail limits the list to events with this invitee; blank lists every invitee's events.

maxStartTime.description: MaxStartTime is the required upper bound of the start-time window; it must be after MinStartTime.

minStartTime.description: MinStartTime is the required inclusive lower bound of the start-time window.

organizationUri.description: OrganizationURI lists every event of an organization, which needs an owner or admin token. When both URIs are blank the connector lists the connected user's own events.

pageSize.description: PageSize is 1 through 100 events per page; zero uses Calendly's default of 20.

pageToken.description: PageToken is the NextPageToken of the previous page; blank reads the first page.

sort.description: Sort is start_time:asc or start_time:desc; blank uses start_time:asc so pages are stable.

status.description: Status is active or canceled; blank lists both.

userUri.description: UserURI limits the list to one user's events, such as https://api.calendly.com/users/<id>. With OrganizationURI it selects one member of an organization the token administers.

factories.name: new_get_scheduled_event_step
factories.description: Read one scheduled event by its Calendly URI.

scheduledEventUri.description: ScheduledEventURI is the event's Calendly URI, such as the scheduledEvent.uri of an InviteeEvent.

factories.name: new_list_event_invitees_step
factories.description: List one bounded page of a scheduled event's invitees.

inputSchema.description: ListEventInviteesInput selects one page of a scheduled event's invitees.

email.description: Email limits the page to one invitee email address; blank lists every invitee.

pageSize.description: PageSize is 1 through 100 invitees per page; zero uses Calendly's default of 20.

pageToken.description: PageToken is the NextPageToken of the previous page; blank reads the first page.

scheduledEventUri.description: ScheduledEventURI is the event's Calendly URI.

status.description: Status is active or canceled; blank lists both.

factories.name: new_cancel_scheduled_event_step
factories.description: Cancel one scheduled event; an event that is already canceled also selects canceled, so a repeated call is safe.

inputSchema.description: CancelScheduledEventInput identifies the scheduled event to cancel.

reason.description: Reason is shown to the invitees in Calendly's cancellation notice; blank sends none. At most 10,000 characters.

scheduledEventUri.description: ScheduledEventURI is the event's Calendly URI.

factories.name: new_create_scheduling_link_step
factories.description: Create one single-use scheduling link for an event type. Calendly has no idempotency key or link lookup. A single-dispatch fence requires sync durability so retry attempts see its heartbeat checkpoints; an unconfirmed accepted write selects uncertain.

inputSchema.description: CreateSchedulingLinkInput names the event type a single-use scheduling link books.

eventTypeUri.description: EventTypeURI is the event type's Calendly URI, such as the eventTypePicker unit's eventTypeUri.

factories.name: new_create_webhook_subscription_step
factories.description: Subscribe a callback URL to invitee webhooks. The connector lists the scope's subscriptions first and reuses one with the same URL, so a repeated call creates at most one subscription.

inputSchema.description: CreateWebhookSubscriptionInput registers one callback URL for invitee webhooks.

callbackUrl.description: CallbackURL is the public HTTPS URL where the application mounts the inviteeEventReceived endpoint, such as https://example.com/webhooks/calendly.

events.description: Events lists invitee.created and invitee.canceled; blank subscribes to both.

organizationUri.description: OrganizationURI owns the subscription; blank uses the connected user's current organization.

scope.description: Scope is user or organization; blank uses user. An organization subscription needs an owner or admin.

userUri.description: UserURI is the user of a user subscription; blank uses the connected user.
